prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: full-bleed desktop web cover hero for a children's career exploration game
Primary request: Create an original premium 3D family-animation-film scene of a cheerful young explorer arriving above a fantastical archipelago of career islands: a wildlife rescue sanctuary, a bright medical research dome, a lively newsroom lighthouse, and a maker workshop. A friendly small flying compass robot guides the child between islands.
Style/medium: polished cinematic stylized 3D animation, original expressive child and companion, rich production design, tactile miniature-island details, feature-film quality; evoke warm family animation craftsmanship without copying any existing franchise or character.
Composition/framing: 16:9 wide; spectacular islands and characters on the right 60%; calm darker teal-to-navy sky and cloud negative space on the left for Chinese title and CTA; strong aerial depth and visual route.
Lighting/mood: sunrise breaking through clouds, optimistic discovery, adventurous but safe.
Color palette: teal blue, sunrise amber, coral orange, fresh green.
Constraints: no text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no UI, no copyrighted characters, no medical symbols with text, no extra limbs.
